name: officeshare-platform
description: OfficeShare Platform - Integrated Corporate Sharing Platform

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm run install-services && npm run install-apps
scripts.install-services: cd services/api-gateway && npm install && cd ../user-service && npm install && cd ../carpooling-service && npm install && cd ../matching-service && npm install && cd ../tracking-service && npm install && cd ../notification-service && npm install && cd ../chat-service && npm install
scripts.install-apps: cd mobile-app && npm install && cd ../admin-dashboard && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:carpooling" "npm run dev:matching" "npm run dev:tracking" "npm run dev:notification" "npm run dev:chat"
scripts.test: npm run test:services && npm run test:apps
scripts.test:services: cd services/api-gateway && npm test && cd ../user-service && npm test && cd ../carpooling-service && npm test && cd ../matching-service && npm test && cd ../tracking-service && npm test && cd ../notification-service && npm test && cd ../chat-service && npm test
scripts.test:apps: cd mobile-app && npm test && cd ../admin-dashboard && npm test
scripts.start:all: concurrently "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:user" "npm run start:carpooling" "npm run start:matching" "npm run start:tracking" "npm run start:notification" "npm run start:chat"

author: OfficeShare Team
